notes.title: Game Updates
notes.content:
Update announcement:
1. Added some hero dynamic effects
2. To optimize the game performance during siege
(a). Cancel the personal artillery during siege, and use the giant catapult of the alliance instead
(b). The number of people that the giant catapult can accommodate has been increased from 50 to 200
(c). The construction cost of the giant catapult has been greatly reduced
3. To take care of individual players and players who occasionally do not participate in the battle in the alliance
Siege [First Clearance Reward] will be directly claimed at the personal progress 15 days after the first clearance of the alliance in this area, consuming the weekly reward times
4. To encourage active participation in siege
(a) .Siege War [Battle Rewards] Added Resource Supply Box
(b).Siege War [Damage Ranking Rewards] (Portal Cooling Stone and Healing Pack) will be issued regardless of whether there are weekly rewards
5.Delete the "Alliance Invite" function, and add the function of sharing alliance hyperlinks in the chat sharing bar
6.Added camera effects to the battle animation details
7.Hero Favorability and Skin Reset are removed from the hero total reset and subdivided into separate reset items, 100 red diamonds each time
However, the hero total reset (now includes: level, advancement, breakthrough, talent) will no longer be counted and charged, and can be reset unlimited times

----------------------
Recently, we have received many letters from lords, saying that they are not in the same time zone as many players in the alliance, or their online time is inconsistent, and they often miss the siege rewards. In this regard, the official operation team attaches great importance to it and actively improves it. Therefore, starting from next week, the Alliance Giant Catapult gameplay will be launched. It will be built by the alliance and settled by alliance members (after settlement, it will provide damage value bonus for the giant catapult). After the alliance administrator declares war on the city, the giant catapult will automatically attack the city within the range. The settled alliance members will also be counted as participating in the war and can receive rewards (if the time does not match the subsequent players, they only need to send one team to settle in the giant catapult in advance)

notes.title: "The maiden and the Lord" Make an appointment to receive the gift code
notes.content:
Dear players, are you ready to embark on a journey full of strategy and adventure? We solemnly announce that the highly anticipated simulation business and strategy adventure game - "Maiden and Lord" has officially landed on the Steam platform and is open for reservations! Join the reservation immediately and become the first city lord to protect your home and build a castle!
[h2][b]Game Introduction: [/b] [/h2]
"Maiden and Lord" is a unique game that combines simulation business, strategic combat and character development. You will play the role of a young city lord, shouldering the responsibility of protecting your home and building a castle. In the game, you need to manage resources, recruit soldiers, develop towns, and deal with sudden monster attacks and mysterious events. Through strategy and wisdom, lead your people to prosperity and uncover the secrets hidden in the dark.
[h3] Core Features: [/h3]
[b] Combination of simulation business and strategy [/b]: Build your castle from scratch, plan the layout of the town, manage resources and population, and create a prosperous home.
[b]Character Development and Interaction[/b]: Recruit unique girls, develop their abilities, and build deep relationships with them.

[b]Strategic Battle[/b]: Build your army, formulate tactics, and repel invading monsters and enemies.

[b]Rich Plot and Exploration[/b]: Uncover the secrets hidden in the darkness and explore unknown map areas.

[b][h2]Pre-order benefits: [/h2][/b]
To thank you for your support, we have prepared generous rewards for pre-order players:

[b]Pre-order bonus[/b]: Ruby x200 Hero Summoning Scroll*5 Resource Supply Box*50 Speed-up Points*50

With a screenshot of the wish list where you added the game, you can contact customer service to get the gift code

Customer service email: liming9964@outlook.com
(Add customer service note: Maiden and Lord)

[b]Early Experience Qualification[/b]: Pre-order players will have the opportunity to participate in the game's early experience and experience the charm of "Maiden and Lord" in advance!

[b]How to pre-order[/b]:
1. Visit the Steam store page of "Maiden and Lord".

2. Click "Follow" and "Add to Wishlist" to complete the pre-order.

3. Follow our official social media to get the latest game information and welfare activities.

[b][h2]Release date: [/h2][/b]
"Maiden and Lord" is expected to be officially released at 10:00 am (UTC-8) on March 5, 2025, so stay tuned!

—— "Maiden and Lord" development team
